t: You're looking at the Dominion Theatre, a West End theatre on Tottenham Court Road, close to St Giles Circus and Centre Point. It opened in 1929, planned mainly as a musical theatre, but the following year it became a cinema. It hosted the London premiere of Charlie Chaplin's City Lights, with Chaplin there in person. Later it joined the Gaumont chain, and it stayed a major premiere cinema until the 1970s, when live concerts began. The architects were William Milburn and Thomas Ridley Milburn, who designed the building.
